text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, I spot an Umamusume
with a
troubled look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I always run with force... No, that's not it.
I make
sure to have fun... and do my
best? That's not it
either...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well... The school newspaper said that
they
wanted to write an article on me...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I've always been really bad at those
kinda
things. I was just thinking about
how I should
respond to their questions.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... I wouldn't have to explain
anything
verbally then.
choice_data_list: トレーニングを実践してみせたら？
苦手なら少しずつ克服してみよう
choice_data_list_en: Why not demonstrate the training yourself?
If you're not good at it, let's try overcoming it little by little.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I'll try doing just that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I shouldn't run away from
things all
the time just because I'm bad
at them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I still don't know what to do...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: メモを用意していったら？
choice_data_list_en: Why don't you prepare a memo?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I'll give it a shot.
